options.label: Enabled
options.description:
Double-tap RS outside combat to toggle the experimental close camera. Double-tap again to return.

Combat/protected states return to the original camera. Calibrated exploration view; eye ownership, wall handling, character clipping and combat detection still need validation.

options.label: Controller button (double-tap)
options.description: Uses Steam Input's Xbox layout. Single clicks still reach the game. Shared bindings can trigger their normal action.

options.label: Camera distance offset (m)
options.description:
Negative values move the camera forward from the game's third-person position. Adjust gradually: try -5, then -6 if -4 is still behind the character. Do not jump directly to -12.

This is a calibration preview, not a validated player-eye anchor. If the camera crosses the character or walls, move this value closer to zero.

options.label: Camera height offset (m)
options.description: Raises or lowers the close camera. Character visibility is not yet modified.

options.label: Camera side offset (m)
options.description: Adjusts left/right placement. Tune it together with distance. The correct eye position depends on the native camera.

options.label: Fine forward offset (m)
options.description: Positive values move the close camera farther forward. Prototype switches are immediate.

options.label: Keyboard fallback (double-tap)
options.description: Double-tap K by default. Set Unbound to use only the controller.

options.label: Maximum click duration (ms)
options.description: Longer holds do not count as clicks.

options.label: Diagnostic logging
options.description: Logs state changes and recognized gestures. No raw controller identifiers are recorded.
